notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Vizzle - Steam Edition
===========================
	• Added more visually appealing menus and dialog boxes throughout.
	• Added Key Indicators to Puzzle Selection screen and on in Game Overlay.
	• Put Tips and Tutorials on background so they are easier to read.
	• Removed Best Scores graphs and replaced them with Best Score boards.
	• Redesigned much of the back end code to better support expandability and future Vizzle versions.

notes.title: Version 1.04 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
Version 1.04 - Release Notes

Vizzle - Steam Edition
===========================
This is a bug fix version for 1.03

[list]
[*] Fixed Capitalization of "SELECT A CHARACTER" title for English Version.
[*] Shifted Puzzles down one so 2 became 1 and 3 became two etc. Needed to shift the puzzle instructions as well.
[*] Disabled the "Back Button" when a puzzle is in "Enjoy the Video" or "Puzzle Summary" modes as it caused problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.01 Released
notes.notes:
New Feature Rotating Pieces
===========================
Puzzles can now support pieces being rotated.
On puzzles with rotated pieces players can single click to rotate a piece 90 degree clockwise.
Puzzle level structure modified to support this new feature. New levels are 3x3, 4x2, 6x3, 6x3 Rotated, 8x4, 8x4 Rotated, 10x5 and 10x5 Rotated. Levels with 14x7 and 16x8 pieces were removed as they were not fun especially now with rotated pieces. 12x6 puzzle may return at some point.

Game Interface Changes
=================
Added Indicators on the left of the puzzle to show active functionality.
*Instruction indicator which can be clicked to reread the puzzle instructions.
*Tutorial indicator that is visible when the puzzle is in tutorial mode.
*Move Indicator that is visible when pieces can be moved.
*Rotation Indicator that is visible when pieces can be rotated.
Improved the look of the "Start Again" and "Level Selection" controls.
Added a 30 reminder to get up and stretch.

Puzzle Changes
==============
Increased the size of the white boarder so edge pieces are now even more easily identified.
Added Instructions to the beginning of each puzzle.
When you select a puzzle you are always taken to the saved level the last time you played. This was confusing for some people since the option you clicked might say a level higher then was saved. To avoid confusion a message as was added "Loaded saved level ## puzzle" so they know why they had been brought to a lower level than they clicked.

Puzzle Selection
================
Improved the "You have an puzzle unlock" message to include the number of unlocks you have if it is more than one.

Option Changes
==============
Added support for multiple languages. This includes all message, UI controls.
I do not speak multiple languages so I used Google translator. Feedback from native speakers of each language would be much appreciated.
Currently testing with only Spanish but if all goes well hope to add all Steam supported languages.

notes.title: Vizzle 1.0 is ready for release on August 13th 2021!
notes.notes: Beta testers have cleared our version 0.7.0 for release to production. It is now our release version 1.0 and  ready for release on August 13th 2021!

notes.title: Release Beta Version 0.7.0
notes.notes:
[b]VDAP36[/b] - Square puzzle pieces required for future functionality of rotation and flipping of pieces.
[b]Resolution[/b]: In order to create square pieces out of a 16x9 video the optimal pieces needed to be calculated and the puzzle board scaled to adjust for minor differences. New Puzzle sizes are.

[i]3x2, 4x2, 6x3, 8x4, 10x6, 12x7, 14x8, 16x9[/i]

In addition puzzle save/load code needed to be modified to save irregular rectangles and not just squares.

[b]VDAP37[/b] - When you complete a level is should advance to the next level of that puzzle when you click. Unless there is a puzzle unlock that takes you back to them menu. Also unless the puzzle is already at level eight. At the moment is always advanced to the highest level of that puzzle.
[b]Resolution[/b]: This has been corrected.

notes.title: Release Beta Version 0.6.0
notes.notes:
[b]VDAP6[/b] - Timed tips come up too quickly and too often.
[b]Resolutio[/b]n: Modified tips to only come up after 90 seconds of no clicking and then every 10 seconds after that. If you click to cancel them it will wait another 90 seconds before it displays them again.

I also modified announcements (The system tips use to display text) so that they can timeout but also be closed sooner by clicking them. Also I always hate when I go to click something and something else pops up under the mouse at the last second. So I modified the announcement system so they can’t be closed unless they are at least 1/2 second old so I know the user intended it. 

[b]VDAP17[/b] - Juggernaut: Multiple sounds when you do something more than one in a turn. For example if you placed 3 pieces play a sound for each piece placed.

[b]VDAP30[/b] - Added An Are you Sure message on the reset button in Options. 
Added a “Game has been reset” announcement after the reset.

[b]VDAP32[/b] - Ignore F12 on the "You Win!" anykey to continue message so you can screen shot in Steam.
[b]Resolution[/b]: Fixed this but also changed the messages after “You Win”. Now you will get notified of any awarded puzzle levels or unlocks immediately after you win. After that the “Continue“ message does come up but it is removed after a few seconds allowing you to enjoy the video.
